§aBetter than coal in every way. Except the gas.§f

Infernal Coal burns for 4,800 ticks, smelting 24 blocks per piece. That's triple regular coal. Found in the Nether at any y-level with any pickaxe.

You can shred it into Coal Powder or combine it with hydrogen peroxide in the Chemical Plant for Solid Fuel. Either way, it's excellent fuel.

§cWARNING:§f Mining the ore releases Monoxide gas. You need a Catalytic or Combo filter in your gas mask to breathe. Hazmat alone won't block CO.

§ePS:§f This is your best early fuel source for the Blast Furnace. Stock up before scaling steel production.
